_readme: Named camera routes for the night renderer, read by scripts/verify/night-compare.mjs.

A pose is either eye/target ([lng, lat, metres above ground] each; bearing and pitch are derived, pitch is clamped to the app's 88 deg and the zoom comes from the app's 58 deg vertical FOV) or a plain MapLibre pose (center, zoom, pitch, bearing).

Because pitch cannot go above the horizon, a target ABOVE the eye clamps to 88 deg: the map centre then lands about 28.6 x the eye height ahead, and the subject sits high in the frame rather than at its centre. Stand far enough back that it still fits.

regions: named rectangles [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the frame (0,0 = top left). A region may be one rectangle or a list of them; rectangles in one region must not overlap. sky/wall/ground/water feed the ratios; any other name (dome, tower) is measured and reported but not divided.

They were read off the 2026-09-19 baseline frames (1440x900) with night-compare --show-regions, which draws them on a labelled 5% grid. After editing them, re-measure an old run with --from instead of re-shooting it.

EVERY pose should carry a wall region: without one the bright-window measure falls back to the whole frame, where at blue hour it counts sky and lit pavement and is not a window count at all (it is then starred in the table).

regimes: slider values. p is canonical (it is what the owner drags); sunElev is what js/sky.js SUN_KEYS gives for that p at c656249, and night-compare warns when a build disagrees by more than 0.5 deg.
refs: optional reference photographs per regime, as paths under refRoot (a local, git-ignored folder; missing files are skipped). None of them may be committed.

West Campus elevated poses are GENERIC vantage points over public streets that frame the same buildings the owner photographed (IMG_9964-9969). The matched poses for those photographs stay in a local overlay file (see night-compare.mjs --local), never here.
